name: Hoshino Madoka
source:
Class: 2-C

[url=/c19341]Megumi's[/url] best friend and an ordinary girl who is a member of the badminton club. While she is satisfied being Megumi's best friend, Madoka has noticed that there is some kind of a wall between their relationship. After [url=/c19333]Taichi's[/url] transfer, Madoka finds out about Megumi being part of the group, and wants to save her from its clutches...

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=804105]Getchu[/url]]
